subject: MAP Kickoff: Redwood MAP draft & timeline options
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Josh Wang <josh.wang@cascadeai.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 04 Mar 2026 10:17:00 -0700
Subject: MAP Kickoff: Redwood MAP draft & timeline options

Hi Josh —

Thanks again for the call this morning — really helpful context on your use case (real‑time summarization for clinical notes + embeddings for search). Attached is an initial Mutual Action Plan (MAP) draft that captures the milestones we discussed, proposed responsibilities, dependencies, and three timeline options.

Quick summary highlights:
- Target close (baseline): May 15, 2026 (standard)
- Milestones:
  1) Pilot scope & success criteria agreed (CascadeAI owners: Miguel)
  2) Security/compliance review (CascadeAI: Priya; Redwood: Security)
  3) POC deployment & validation (Redwood SE: Aditya)
  4) Commercial terms & signature (Legal teams)
- Dependencies: SOC 2 evidence, access to a sanitized subset of logs, and a short MSA redline pass

Timeline options included in the sheet:
- Aggressive: 4 weeks (high effort, riskier for SOC2)
- Standard: 8 weeks (recommended)
- Extended: 12 weeks (if procurement or legal windows are long)

Ask: can you confirm the stakeholder list (CISO, VP Eng, Procurement) and whether we should target the standard timeline or push to June 1? Once you confirm, I’ll lock the MAP, assign owners in the document, and loop in Aditya for SE kickoff.

Attachments: CascadeAI_MAP_v1.xlsx (MAP draft), Redwood_MAP_template.pdf

Thanks —
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

From: Josh Wang <josh.wang@cascadeai.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Sharma <priya.sharma@cascadeai.com>, Miguel Lopez <miguel.lopez@cascadeai.com>
Date: Wed, 04 Mar 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP Kickoff: Redwood MAP draft & timeline options

Thanks Marissa — appreciate the clear writeup and the MAP. A few quick notes:

- Stakeholders: please add Priya Sharma (CISO) and Miguel Lopez (VP Eng) as primary reviewers. I’ll also loop procurement (TBD) once we have high‑level T&Cs.
- Target close: we’re aiming for end of Q2; June 1 would be much safer for our internal release schedule. Can we move the baseline to June 1?
- SOC 2 evidence: Priya noted we’ll need ~2 weeks to pull scoped evidence and an external auditor report excerpt. That will be a hard dependency for the security signoff milestone.

I skimmed the MAP and the milestones look right. Let’s plan the SE kickoff next week — Miguel prefers afternoons.

– Josh
Josh Wang
Head of Platform, CascadeAI
josh.wang@cascadeai.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>

Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Priya Sharma <priya.sharma@cascadeai.com>, Miguel Lopez <miguel.lopez@cascadeai.com>
Date: Wed, 04 Mar 2026 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP Kickoff: Redwood MAP draft & timeline options

Thanks Josh —

That all makes sense. I updated the MAP to set the target close to June 1 (standard timeline) and explicitly called out the SOC 2 evidence as a dependency with a 2‑week lead time. I also mapped owners: Priya for security signoff, Miguel for pilot acceptance, and Aditya for SE delivery.

Next steps:
1) Can Priya confirm she’s the right security contact and whether she needs any specific evidence templates from us?
2) Miguel — can you confirm availability for an SE kickoff next Wed or Thu afternoon (I listed both options in the sheet)?
3) Josh — I’ve added a HubSpot deal link and uploaded the MAP to the shared Drive for easy edits.

Attachments: CascadeAI_MAP_v1.xlsx (updated), Redwood_MAP_template.pdf
Links: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/4821, https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cMAP

If that looks good I’ll lock the MAP and send calendar invites for the SE kickoff and a security handoff meeting.

Best —
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
